findings.message: Entry params colaboradorId, categoria and page filter the list but no state holds them; added persisted public states colaboradorId, categoria and page (set through listarDespesasAprovadas).
The selectedDespesa param (id) had no public selection method; added selectDespesaAprovadaDetalhe(id | null), which fetches the record through obterDespesaAprovada into despesa.
registrarPagamento has a typed field (dataPagamento) but no <command>.input state; added registrarPagamentoDraft with setRegistrarPagamentoDraft.

registrarPagamento returns despesa, which is applied to despesa and removed from despesas items, but the list page/hasMore and pageStatus (e.g. empty queue) are not refreshed because the route does not return them.
public categoria is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
